name: pi-vibeguard
notes: Forked from aizigao/pi-vibeguard (npm @aizigao/pi-vibeguard v0.1.2). Local divergence per openspec change add-vibeguard-mapping-command: (1) npm renamed to @xzzpig/pi-vibeguard, fork version 0.1.0, repository field repointed to xzzpig/pi-extensions; (2) added peerDependency @earendil-works/pi-tui (range aligned with pi-tool-display) plus vitest devDep for the new tests; (3) index.ts: appended inline Mapping View section (parseCategoryFromPlaceholder/maskOriginal/buildMappingSnapshot/buildCategoryStats/formatTtlRemaining + MappingViewModal TUI overlay) and registered /vibeguard:list and /vibeguard:stats (ctx.ui.custom only, zero session writes; command layer reuses the engine's own cleanup before snapshotting); (4) tests/ added (vitest unit + extension-level integration); tsconfig include widened (tests, test-engine, allowImportingTsExtensions) and eslint ignores test-engine.ts (upstream standalone script); (5) README fork notice + CHANGELOG 0.1.0 fork entry.
